chapter: Hutto 1978-79: NBC, radio and the N'goma drums
title: Johnny Williams, a rival drummer
summary: Morehouse calls drummer Johnny Williams his rival and admires his facility; Hutto discusses the Spivak-related record.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Well we have that and we'll play them for you after a while.
All right, I wish you would.
Okay, there is one more there. On one side of the record it's Johnny Williams.
That side, you know he really beats it out.
Yeah, oh he was a hell of a good drummer. I wish I had his facility.
He plays 'I'll Build a Stairway to Paradise.' And it was the song that Charlie Spivak, some of the same people that were on the other side.
